Puerto Rico has one documented data center facility in this dataset, a Microsoft installation in Guaynabo, with zero megawatts of reported load capacity.

The single facility is recorded without a power figure. A total_mw of zero means either the draw was not reported, not measured at time of generation, or not captured by the source that feeds this record. The absence of a number is not evidence that the facility consumes no power, only that no figure is available here.

What the data does not cover is significant. It says nothing about facility size, compute density, connectivity to Puerto Rico's grid, or whether additional facilities exist but are untracked. Puerto Rico operates a distinct electrical system from the continental United States, which would make grid constraints locally specific, but nothing in this record speaks to that relationship.
